development_record.interpretation: The executed draft protocol had no behavioral or construction failures. This statement is limited to this draft report; unrelated development audits or static lint are not counted as runtime failures or as additional experiment cases.

omissions: Repeated full states, tool schemas and observation bodies are retained in the referenced raw files rather than duplicated here; raw file hashes and exact record sequences are included.
The actual worker calls, committed read/write records, content evaluations, every contract check, and all version/mirror hashes are retained in this archive.
Full transition receipts remain in raw committed state; this archive copies the associated identity, inputs, output and read/write inventory rather than duplicating receipt path lists.

interpretation.main: Four expected scenario outcomes and 28 checks passed: three actual submissions (values 13, 27, 33) and one zero-action missing-route wait. This is not four completed deliveries.
interpretation.supplement: One unavailable-route case is a separate 8-check probe. It made one advertised request and two one-tick waits, then stopped with explicit unavailability without a submission.
interpretation.boundary: One owned finite source-to-JSON task per session; tools/contracts determine all worker inputs. No model calls, training, professional finance correctness, or general-agent planning claim.
interpretation.measurement_access: Only the worker is limited to the opaque public port. Setup and post-run measurement use trusted runtime APIs and persisted records; the measurement is not claimed to be restricted to the worker port.
